claim_scope.population: 40 previously unexposed questions, eight in each of five available question types
claim_scope.excluded_type: preference (untouched source supply exhausted before r6)
claim_scope.treatment: ARE ranked whole-turn memory projection, 5000-character budget
claim_scope.primary_metric: paired strict-correct-rate difference over all 40 questions

review_wording: On a prespecified, previously unexposed 40-question LongMemEval-S cohort spanning five available question types, with GLM-5.3-flash at an 8K request window, ARE's ranked memory projection answered 22/40 (55.0%) correctly versus 5/40 (12.5%) for a sequential retained-note control. The paired accuracy difference was +42.5 percentage points (stratified paired-bootstrap 95% interval +27.5 to +57.5 points).

method.strata: five question types, eight questions each
method.seed: first eight hex digits of frozen source-manifest SHA-256

claim_ceiling: Accuracy superiority only for the prespecified five-type, 40-question GLM-5.3-flash 8K memory comparison. No six-type/full LongMemEval-S, general workflow, all-model, cost, speed, or broad ARE-product superiority claim.
